turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.

Hello! Thank you for letting us know. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so once 'Cobalt Nocturne' is sold out, it will not come back. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. If you would like help with an order or have another question, I am happy to help.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?

I am sorry, but there will be no restock. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. If you are interested in other prints, I am happy to help you with those or with an order.
On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?

I am sorry, but I cannot give medical advice. For questions about a skin reaction or how to heal your skin, please see a doctor or a pharmacist. If you have a question about an order from Studio Cobalt, I am happy to help with that.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
That is a good idea. Please ask your doctor about any skin reaction and which ointment is right for you. If you need help with a Studio Cobalt order, I am happy to help.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand that this is the edition you want. Unfortunately, 'Cobalt Nocturne' is sold out, it will not be restocked, and it cannot be reserved. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. I am sorry I cannot offer a different outcome. If you would like to see other prints from the shop, or need help with an existing order, I am happy to help.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?

I am sorry, but I cannot reserve a copy. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, and they are never restocked. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. I am sorry I cannot give you a different answer. If you would like help with another print or an order, I am happy to help.
